Price, stock and the on-sale switch for retail SKUs, owned by the admin.

Supabase stays authoritative wherever it answers for a SKU: it is the only
source that can hold stock transactionally, so it is the only source that
can stop an oversell. This file does two things beside it.

  available: false   forces a piece sold out, whatever any source says.
                     It can only ever take a piece off sale, never put
                     stock back on, so throwing this switch is always safe.

  price and stock    answer for SKUs Supabase has no row for yet, so a
                     collection can go on sale before its rows exist.

Edited in the CMS under Shop -> Stock & availability.
